title: GTA V: Alternate Timelines
subtitle: Three criminals, one sunny city, and enough ego to crash the economy twice.

achievements.title: Perfect Crew
achievements.description: Keep all three leads alive and rich.

achievements.title: Market Crash
achievements.description: Win by breaking the financial elite.

achievements.title: Retirement Plan
achievements.description: Walk away before the next betrayal.

failed_score.title: Failed Score
text: A small payroll robbery turns into a freeway war because one crew member brought the wrong van and another brought feelings.
Now all three of you are connected by debt, leverage, and the mutual understanding that none of you should ever make a calendar together.
Sunfall County shines in postcard colors while your life catches fire in real time.

choices.label: Let the veteran planner call the next move
Let the young hustler chase high-risk opportunities

safehouse_split.title: Safehouse Split
text: In a mansion borrowed from people currently very upset with you, the crew debates strategy over stolen wine and poor communication.
The veteran wants structure, the hustler wants momentum, and the wildcard wants to buy a tank online.
You need money fast and trust faster. One of those is harder to counterfeit.

choices.label: Plan a disciplined jewelry district heist

street_wave.title: Street Wave
text: You hit armored vans, influencer mansions, and one cryptocurrency startup whose security password was literally password.
Cash flows in, law enforcement closes in, and the crew starts scoring points in the ancient sport of blaming each other.
A fixer offers bigger work tied to corporate sabotage and political donors.

choices.label: Take fixer contracts and go upscale
Go loud and build fear-based control

desert_madness.title: Desert Madness
text: Out in the county desert, private militias and paranoid entrepreneurs sell heavy equipment with loyalty programs and no refunds.
The wildcard thrives, the veteran drinks in silence, and the hustler checks real estate listings between firefights.
You secure military-grade toys and military-grade headaches.

choices.label: Sell hardware to rivals for liquidity

corporate_angles.title: Corporate Angles
text: A tech billionaire and a media baron are quietly funding opposite sides of the same city contract war.
They both hire you through shell companies, assuming criminals cannot read spreadsheets. They are wrong, and their accountants should panic.
Now you can play kingmaker, burn both, or cut your own route to the central bank vault.

choices.label: Play both elites and inflate your cut
Leak their secrets and weaponize public rage

federal_pressure.title: Federal Pressure
text: A federal task force arrives with drones, subpoenas, and enough ego to power the western grid.
They offer immunity for one crew member if the other two become historical footnotes.
The crew has reached the trust exercise phase, which in your line of work means checking who loaded extra magazines.

choices.label: Reject the offer and keep the crew unified
Secretly flip one member for legal cover
Cash out and disappear before endgame

sunfall_endgame.title: Sunfall Endgame
text: The final operation targets money, power, and narrative control: city data centers, elite bank routes, and televised scandal releases all in one night.
Your crew can walk out as legends, corpses, or consultants on a federal slide deck.
The sun rises over helicopters, influencer livestreams, and one very confused stock market.

choices.label: Keep the crew alive and split everything
Ruin the elite and crash their financial game

ending_perfect_crew.title: Perfect Crew
text: Against all statistical probability, all three of you survive, rich and still speaking.
Sunfall calls you criminals. Financial media calls you disruptive innovators.

ending.title: Perfect Crew
ending.summary: You keep the crew intact and win big together.

ending_sunset_king.title: Sunset King
text: You consolidate Sunfall's underworld, private security sector, and enough corrupt officials to host a governance workshop.
It is not democracy, but it is efficient.

ending.title: Sunset King
ending.summary: You seize long-term control of Sunfall's criminal economy.

ending_market_crash.title: Market Crash
text: You expose elite corruption and reroute fortunes in one surgical night of mayhem.
The rich stay rich, but now they are also publicly embarrassed, which in their world is basically prison.

ending.title: Market Crash
ending.summary: You weaponize finance and chaos to break the elite's grip.

ending_retirement_plan.title: Retirement Plan
text: You leave with enough money to never work again and enough paranoia to never sleep again.
Sunfall keeps shining. You keep moving.

ending.title: Retirement Plan
ending.summary: You walk away before betrayal finishes the crew.
